title: Crossroads of Blood - How to Earn & Missable Status
description: Crossroads of Blood trophy in Phantom Blade Zero - how to earn it, whether it is missable, and how the PS5 and Steam lists differ.
keyword: Crossroads of Blood phantom blade zero trophy

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: One of the optional region bosses that is easy to walk past if you take the main road through.

sections.title: Source Status
sections.content: Trophy 11 of 36 on the list - before it Sword Against the Seven-Stars · after it Nothing Goes to Waste. It is not missable, so a missed run can be finished later without a restart. The full list with rarity is on the trophy list; the Platinum route and the order to do things in are on the trophy guide.
